notes: 2.8.10 - Fixes the program stopping by itself after a macOS update: the desktop icon now asks macOS itself to run the program, so it is no longer ended when the icon's launcher quits. If that is not possible it falls back to the old way. macOS may show a background item notice the first time; choose Allow. Also includes 2.8.9 (API key box in Settings, authenticity default Risky brands only) and 2.8.8 (30 watches).
